evals.prompt: hey can you make me a bar chart showing how many short links were created each day this week? save it as a png in a media folder at the root of the project
evals.expected_output: A PNG bar chart at media/ in the project root with days (Mon–Sun) on the x-axis and number of links created on the y-axis, generated by querying the database for the current week's link counts.

evals.prompt: I need a visual for our weekly sync — plot links generated per day for the current week (days on the x-axis, count on the y-axis) and export it to media/ as a PNG file.
evals.expected_output: A PNG bar chart in the media/ folder covering the current Monday–Sunday week, with daily link creation counts from the database, days with zero links still shown.

evals.prompt: Create a graph of this week's daily link creation numbers from our Postgres database and put the PNG in the project's media folder. Also tell me which day had the most links.
evals.expected_output: A PNG bar chart in media/ built from real database counts for the current week, plus a short statement naming the day with the highest count, consistent with the data.
